source_lock.scope: Isolated, valueless harness. It compiles and executes the upstream FCMP++ and CARROT primitives at the pins below. It is not a node, not a network, and not an audit.

upstream.rebase_risk: fcmp++-stage is a moving integration branch. This pin is a commit hash, not a branch name. Evidence records upstream-head.txt and the vector hashes so a later rebase is detectable.
primitives_used: src/fcmp_pp (prove.h: prove_membership, verify_membership, prove_sal, verify_sal, verify)
src/cryptonote_basic (address base58 encode/decode used by CARROT destinations)

alternatives_rejected.v0.19.0.0-beta.2.0 (8ed2f782): pins monero-oxide 0e438aed (2026-04-23), which predates the Trail of Bits fix commit 066229801a18bb11679113c93971c4f19fde0cd0 included at 31c26d96
alternatives_rejected.beta-stressnet-v3 (5288ee13cbea1c5840569: same monero-oxide pin; stress-net branch, not the integration head
alternatives_rejected.monero-project/monero master (d02c7c57): contains only the early FCMP++ integration phases

rust.crate_licenses: MIT (crypto/fcmps, crypto/generalized-bulletproofs, crypto/divisors, crypto/helioselene LICENSE files at 31c26d96)
rust.fetch: cargo fetch --locked on the host into the gitignored build/vanguard-src/cargo-home; the container build runs with CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true and --network=none

builder.image_note: The accepted testnet v0 builder image, used read-only by image ID with --pull=never. It is not retagged or modified. It carries no Rust, so the host toolchain below is mounted read-only.
builder.rustc_note: Upstream CI (.github/workflows/build.yml at the pin) installs toolchain 1.93 via rustup-init 1.29.0

public_review_references.caveat: These are third-party reviews of upstream components, cited only as references. None of them is an audit of Meownero, of this harness, or of the pinned integration commit as a whole. Agent review is not external audit.
